actions.name: Exploit CVE-2023-46805 and CVE-2024-21887 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution
actions.description: Threat actors exploited CVE-2023-46805 and CVE-2024-21887 vulnerabilities in Ivanti Connect Secure and Ivanti Policy Secure gateways to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution by chaining these vulnerabilities.

actions.name: Deploy web shells GLASSTOKEN and GIFTEDVISITOR on internal and external-facing web servers
actions.description: Threat actors exploited vulnerabilities to implant web shells including GLASSTOKEN and GIFTEDVISITOR on internal and external-facing web servers to execute commands on compromised devices.

actions.name: Bypass initial mitigations to deploy BUSHWALK, LIGHTWIRE, and CHAINLINE web shell variants
actions.description: After Ivanti provided initial mitigation guidance, threat actors developed a way to bypass those mitigations to deploy BUSHWALK, LIGHTWIRE, and CHAINLINE web shell variants.

actions.name: Exploit CVE-2024-21893 to access restricted resources without authentication
actions.description: Threat actors exploited CVE-2024-21893, a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the SAML component of Ivanti Connect Secure and Ivanti Policy Secure gateways, to access restricted resources without authentication.

actions.name: Exploit CVE-2024-22024 to access restricted resources without authentication
actions.description: Threat actors exploited CVE-2024-22024, an XML vulnerability in the SAML component of Ivanti Connect Secure, Ivanti Policy Secure, and ZTA gateways, to access restricted resources without authentication.

actions.name: Exploit CVE-2024-21888 to gain elevated administrator privileges
actions.description: Threat actors exploited CVE-2024-21888, a privilege escalation vulnerability in the web component of Ivanti Connect Secure and Ivanti Policy Secure, to gain elevated privileges to that of an administrator.

actions.name: Harvest credentials stored on Ivanti devices
actions.description: Threat actors exploited vulnerabilities to harvest credentials stored on Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure devices.

actions.name: Move laterally into domain environments using native Ivanti tools
actions.description: Post-compromise, threat actors moved laterally into domain environments leveraging native Ivanti appliance tools such as freerdp, ssh, telnet, and nmap libraries to expand access.

actions.name: Achieve full domain compromise
actions.description: In some cases, the threat actors' lateral movement and exploitation resulted in full domain compromise.

actions.name: Bypass Ivanti internal and external Integrity Checker Tool (ICT) detection
actions.description: Threat actors bypassed Ivanti’s internal and external Integrity Checker Tool, which failed to detect compromise due to web shells present without file mismatches and adversaries cleaning up evidence.

actions.name: Maintain root-level persistence despite factory resets and appliance upgrades
actions.description: Threat actors maintained root-level persistence on Ivanti appliances despite factory resets and upgrades by storing persistence mechanisms on encrypted partitions and deceiving integrity checkers.

actions.name: Exfiltrate domain administrator cleartext credentials
actions.description: Threat actors used root-level access obtained from vulnerabilities to exfiltrate domain administrator cleartext credentials stored on Ivanti appliances.

actions.name: Exfiltrate base64 encoded active directory cleartext passwords and NTLM hashes for active and inactive sessions
actions.description: Threat actors exfiltrated base64 encoded active directory cleartext passwords and NTLM password hashes for users with active and previous sessions by accessing backups of data.mdb database files stored on the appliance.
